intentComment: Story 056 — cut index-4 dispatcher over to a Sky-PSM BalancerPoolerV2 + new MintDebtHook (migrate BPT+sUSDS, manual Sky-route validation, final pool())

dry.note: PREVIEW_MODE=true -> isPreview=true -> run() takes vm.startPrank(OWNER_ADDRESS) (impersonate owner), no broadcast. ADDITIONALLY enables the preview-only step 16 (deal USDS to owner, mint one id-4 NFT) and step 17 LP add. No node pre/post scripts on the dry variant.

broadcast.note: PREVIEW_MODE unset -> isPreview=false -> run() takes vm.startBroadcast() (ledger-signed, HD index 46). Step 16 (preview e2e mint, uses the deal cheatcode) is gated behind isPreview and NEVER runs on broadcast. --skip-simulation is required because (a) the final pool() relies on an offline-derived DEFAULT_MIN_BPT (Balancer V3 query path reverts NotStaticCall from a tx frame) and (b) forge's local broadcast-collection pass would otherwise abort on a too-high minBPT; the script self-guards via internal require/asserts and isolates pool() in try/catch.
